 National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto at Rupatama Mabes Polri, Jakarta, Monday (3/11/2026). (KOMPAS.com/BAHARUDIN AL FARISI) 
 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto has reassigned several police chiefs within the National Police Corps.
 This reorganization is outlined in the National Police Chief's Telegram Letter (ST) Number ST/2467/XI/KEP./2026 dated November 2, 2026.
 The officers affected by this reshuffle include:
 Bandung Police Chief Kombes Pol Imran Amir replacing Kombes Pol Dedi Supriyadi
 Palembang Police Chief Kombes Pol Heru Agung Nugroho replacing Kombes Pol Sonny Mahar Budi
 Kombes Pol Alfian Nurizal becomes South Jakarta Metro Police Chief replacing Kombes Pol I Putu Yuni Setiawan
 Kombes Pol Hendri Umar becomes East Jakarta Metro Police Chief replacing Kombes Pol Alfian Nurizal.
 Bangkalan Police Chief AKBP Mustijat Priyambodo replaces AKBP Rossa Purbo Bekti.
 The Head of the Public Relations Division of the National Police, Irjen Pol Johnny Eddizon Isir, stated that reshuffling is a normal process within the police organization.
 "Mutations and rotations of positions are part of the dynamics of the organization and the career development of police personnel," said Isir in a press release on Tuesday (3/11/2026).
 According to Isir, this reshuffle also aims to refresh the organization to ensure effective leadership and execution of duties.
 Isir expressed appreciation and gratitude to the previous officials for their dedication, service, and contributions during their tenure.
 He hopes that the experiences and achievements they have made will strengthen the National Police organization in the future.
 "Meanwhile, to those taking on new responsibilities, we hope they can quickly adapt, understand the characteristics of their work environment, and continue the programs and policies that have been successfully implemented," Isir added.
